page.layout: Running head at top with page number 149 at upper left. One column of main text, with paragraphs XII to XV, then running prose below. Two marginal notes in the left margin: one beside the paragraph "Quemadmodum", one beside the paragraph "epistolæ sententiis".

main_text.p: XII. Quo res effent vestræ in loco, cum hafce exarabam literas, ignorabam.
XIII. Rumores quidem hic de vobis sparge-batur tristes, sed ἀλλ' ἄδικοι[?], & jam rauci sunt facti.
XIIII. Itaque falsos & fuisse existimo: & esse cupio.
XV. Tu tamen, si cura me & solicitudine libe-rare magna volueris, de omnibus ad me primo quo-que tempore scribes, & quod facis, me meaq; studia commendata tibi habebis.

De ratione respondendi ad aliorum gratulationes.Quemadmodum vero amicorum, hoc est, munus, ut de fortuna prospera succes-suque rerum prospero amicis gratulen-tur: ita vicissim hoc à doctis & bonis viris requiritur: ut gratis animis eiusmodi officium agnoscant, idque missis ad amicos literis testatum faciant. Neque vero difficile hoc erit iis, qui quonam pacto respondendum, & gratiæ sint agendæ illis, qui commendationibus, aut aliis nobis officiis adfuerunt, cognitum jam perspe-ctumque habent. Plerunque enim tales Sententiæ in respondendo observandæ.epistolæ sententiis constant εὐχαριστικῶς[?] gratias agentibus: ἐπαινετικῶς[?] amici studium atque officium laudantibus & amplificantibus, petitis: à causis, effectis, adjunctis, & persona eorum qui gratulantur: comparatione & collatione: συγκριτικῶς[?] grati

page.notes: Greek words in the first paragraph and in the paragraph "epistolæ sententiis" are uncertain at several points; the line-end word "grati" runs on to the next page. "sparge-batur" has a tilde over the a in "bātur" that is hard to read. The left note "respondë-do observan-dæ" is set in small type and was read as "respondendo observandæ". The Greek in the XIII line is partly illegible.
